verses.text: A prayer of David. Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

xrefs.text: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.

Incline Your ear, O my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears Your name. For we are not presenting our petitions before You because of our righteous acts, but because of Your great compassion.
But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.
“Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.

verses.text: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.

xrefs.text: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.
But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.

verses.text: Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.

xrefs.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.
My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.
Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.

For the choirmaster. To the tune of “A Dove on Distant Oaks.” A Miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.

verses.text: Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

xrefs.text: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
Of David. To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;
As a mother comforts her son, so will I comfort you, and you will be consoled over Jerusalem.”
Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.

to console the mourners in Zion— to give them a crown of beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, and a garment of praise for a spirit of despair. So they will be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He may be glorified.

verses.text: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.

xrefs.text: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
So rend your hearts and not your garments, and return to the LORD your God. For He is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion. And He relents from sending disaster.
Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out: “The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness,
The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.

They refused to listen and failed to remember the wonders You performed among them. They stiffened their necks and appointed a leader to return them to their bondage in Egypt. But You are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in loving devotion, and You did not forsake them.

verses.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.

xrefs.text: For the choirmaster, to be accompanied by flutes. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.
A prayer of David. Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer— it comes from lips free of deceit.
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. Listen to my prayer, O God, and do not ignore my plea.
O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.

verses.text: In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.

xrefs.text: saying: “In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered me. From the belly of Sheol I called for help, and You heard my voice.
I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
I call on You, O God, for You will answer me. Incline Your ear to me; hear my words.
Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”
During the days of Jesus’ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.

verses.text: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.

xrefs.text: Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You— majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?
“O Lord GOD, You have begun to show Your greatness and power to Your servant. For what god in heaven or on earth can perform such works and mighty acts as Yours?
For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?

Therefore I decree that the people of any nation or language who say anything offensive against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego will be cut into pieces and their houses reduced to rubble. For there is no other god who can deliver in this way.”
“To whom will you liken Me, or who is My equal?” asks the Holy One.

verses.text: All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.

xrefs.text: Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.
From one New Moon to another and from one Sabbath to another, all mankind will come to worship before Me,” says the LORD.
All the earth bows down to You; they sing praise to You; they sing praise to Your name.” Selah
In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established as the chief of the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and all nations will stream to it.
Then the seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and loud voices called out in heaven: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever.

verses.text: For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.

xrefs.text: “O LORD of Hosts, God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, You alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You made the heavens and the earth.
Jesus replied, “This is the most important: ‘Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is One.
Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
So about eating food sacrificed to idols: We know that an idol is nothing at all in the world, and that there is no God but one.
See now that I am He; there is no God besides Me. I bring death and I give life; I wound and I heal, and there is no one who can deliver from My hand.

verses.text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.

xrefs.text: They will be My people, and I will be their God.
Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.
Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.

verses.text: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.

xrefs.text: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!
In that day you will say: “O LORD, I will praise You. Although You were angry with me, Your anger has turned away, and You have comforted me.

verses.text: For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.

xrefs.text: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.
For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead— Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.

verses.text: The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life; they have no regard for You.

xrefs.text: For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life— men with no regard for God. Selah
When morning came, all the chief priests and elders of the people conspired against Jesus to put Him to death.
At that time the chief priests and elders of the people assembled in the courtyard of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,
Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD. An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.text: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.

xrefs.text: But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.

verses.text: Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.

xrefs.text: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.
Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.
Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.

verses.text: Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

xrefs.text: But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.
Gideon answered, “If I have found favor in Your sight, give me a sign that it is You speaking with me.
Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes, You will revive me once again. Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up.
Do not discard me in my old age; do not forsake me when my strength fails.
Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.
